dedupe_keys.name: hydrocron swot river time series api

description: Hydrocron is NASA PO.DAAC's API for retrieving time series from Surface Water and Ocean Topography satellite products. It reshapes river reach or node observations into CSV or GeoJSON responses, selecting a feature, collection, dates and fields. Outputs can contain surface-water elevation, slope and width for modelling or checking river conditions. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the available SWOT collections. The server source is free under Apache-2.0. A public API and examples are documented, while a local development installation uses Python, Docker and DynamoDB. The README warns that parts of the local installation guide are out of date and may break; most users are directed to the hosted API. Data access has separate provider rules. Hydrocron prepares observational boundary or validation inputs for river and flood simulations but does not itself forecast flow. The API design was inspected without sending a data request or downloading SWOT records.
name: Hydrocron SWOT river time-series API
